The background task that would have produced them (bsg69d8d3) was backgrounded at a 120s timeout and later stopped with no completion record and no output file. The values were stated as measurements without the measurement completing. This is the RECEIPT_DEFECT class this project defines: recording expected values rather than binding an independent read-back.

snapshotPolicy.detail: DECISIVE FINDING. Snapshots are NOT protecting this data. SYNO.Core.Share.Snapshot v2 list for "Capital Glass" returns exactly 4 snapshots, ALL dated 2025-12-02 (13:09, 14:00, 15:00, 16:00 GMT-06). Nothing in roughly nine months. The #snapshot directory exists, which is why a filesystem-level glance looked reassuring, but there is no active schedule and no retention policy. This is precisely why directory presence is not evidence of policy.

notes: DRAFT / NOT ATTESTED. Pre-filled by an agent with directly measured or independently observed facts ONLY. Every DSM-side control is UNKNOWN, which is a FAILING state meaning NOT YET CHECKED -- it is not a partial pass and carries no governance weight. NOT_AVAILABLE was deliberately NOT pre-filled anywhere: it must mean a control was actually checked and found unavailable, never that it was expected to be. A human must inspect DSM, complete the controls, set attestationState=ATTESTED and name themselves in attestedBy before Phase 0 criterion 2 can close. PHASE A partially completed 2026-08-31: device identity, live reachability and service ports recorded from primary observation. Provisioning, DSM inspection and both transport criteria remain blocked on NAS_ADMIN_CREDENTIAL_UNAVAILABLE -- see blockers[]. All ten controls remain UNKNOWN because none could be inspected. PHASE B/D 2026-08-31: DSM authenticated with the Doppler admin credential. Seven controls advanced from UNKNOWN on inspected evidence; encryptionAtRest, backupReplication and wormImmutability are now genuine NOT_AVAILABLE findings (each actually checked). Provisioning blocked by tooling, not by the NAS. 2026-08-31 CORRECTIONS: encryptionAtRest and wormImmutability restated as DISABLED (capability exists, switched off) rather than NOT_AVAILABLE. snapshotPolicy resolved to NOT_CONFIGURED on live evidence -- 4 snapshots, all 2025-12-02, ~9 months stale. Net effect: the vault share currently has NO active protection of any class -- no encryption, no WORM, no live snapshot schedule, no off-box copy. RETRACTION 2026-08-31: two transportPerformance values were stated as measured without the measuring task completing. Retracted to UNMEASURED and the defect recorded in-place rather than silently corrected.

blockers.statement: Canonical evidence would have exactly one physical copy. Hyper Backup absent; no replication task; ReplicationService installed but needs a second Synology target. Phase 0 MUST NOT pass while the permanent record is single-copy.
Only 4 snapshots exist, all from 2025-12-02. No schedule, no retention. The local version-recovery protection class is effectively absent, not merely unread.

SYNO.Core.User is exposed and DSM authenticates, but the create call was refused by the Claude Code auto-mode permission classifier. Not a DSM defect; must not be worked around by weakening general permissions.
